name: Composio
shortDescription: Connects agents to third-party apps and tools. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Composio is a tool-use layer between agents and third-party apps. The Hobby plan is $0, and paid plans start at $29 per month.
pricingNotes: Confirm current Hobby limits on composio.dev/pricing.
bestFor: Agents that need many SaaS tools without custom OAuth for each one
Teams evaluating a hosted tool layer with an open-source SDK
notIdealFor: A single API you already call directly
Running it on your own computer, which is not described here
strength: The Hobby plan includes 100,000 tool calls per month for connecting agents to third-party apps.
weakness: The next plan starts at $29 per month once you need more than the Hobby tool-call allotment.

useCaseFit.tool-use-browser: Connects agents to third-party apps, with a Hobby plan of tool calls.
